series.name: SUN2000-USL0 LED1/LED2/LED3 indicator states (Table 2-2 LED description)
series.notes: Distinct LED table from SERIES 2 (M0). USL0 adds orange backup-state rows and red-slow optimizer-fault rows that do not exist in the M0 table. Codes are LED state strings, not numeric alarm IDs.

codes.code: LED1 Steady orange + LED2 Steady orange
aliases: LED1 Steady orange + LED2 Steady orange

title.ur: Backup state mein chal raha hai (island/backup mode)

meaning.en: Both running LEDs solid orange: the inverter is supplying a local backup load instead of following the grid.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs solid orange: inverter grid ke bajaye local backup load ko supply kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid lost while backup output was enabled, so the inverter is islanding the backup circuit.
causes.ur: Backup output on hone ke baad grid chala gaya, is liye inverter backup circuit island kar raha hai.

solutions.en: No fault action; verify in the app that backup mode is intentional for this site.
solutions.ur: Koi fault action nahi; app par confirm karein ke backup mode is site ke liye qasd se on hai.

solutions.en: If backup was not expected, check the backup enable button and the critical-load AC wiring.
solutions.ur: Agar backup expected nahi tha to backup enable button aur critical-load AC wiring check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Table 2-2 LED description

codes.code: LED1 Blinking orange at long intervals + LED2 Off
aliases: LED1 Blinking orange at long intervals + LED2 Off

meaning.en: DC is on and the SUN2000 has no output while in backup state.
meaning.ur: DC on hai aur SUN2000 backup state mein koi output nahi de raha.

causes.en: Grid is absent and the backup load is not drawing current.
causes.ur: Grid nahi hai aur backup load current nahi kheech raha.

causes.en: Backup output not enabled via the backup enable button.
causes.ur: Backup enable button se backup output enable nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Check the critical-load breaker is closed and measure voltage on the backup output with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke critical-load breaker bandh nahi hai aur multimeter se backup output par voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the backup enable button on the unit is pressed as per the manual.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke manual ke mutabiq unit par backup enable button daba hua hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If grid is present and backup output is still dead, check the neutral-earth bonding in the backup sub-panel.
solutions.ur: Agar grid mojood hai lekin backup output ab bhi dead hai to backup sub-panel mein neutral-earth bonding check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED1 blinking orange at long intervals (on 1s, off 1s), LED2 off

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Table 2-2 LED description

codes.code: LED1 Steady red + LED2 Steady red
aliases: LED1 Steady red + LED2 Steady red

meaning.en: Both running LEDs solid red - the manual states the SUN2000 is faulty. Get the numeric alarm from the app.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs solid red - manual ke mutabiq SUN2000 faulty hai. Numeric alarm app se lein.

causes.en: Internal device fault, e.g. alarm 2064 Device Fault.
causes.ur: Internal device fault, maslan alarm 2064 Device Fault.

causes.en: Battery fault with the unit, e.g. alarm 2068 Battery Abnormal.
causes.ur: Unit ke saath battery fault, maslan alarm 2068 Battery Abnormal.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm ID in the app before touching the AC or DC side.
solutions.ur: AC ya DC side chhune se pehle app mein numeric alarm ID padhein.

solutions.en: Power off in documented order (AC output switch, then DC input switch) and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Documented order se band karein (AC output switch, phir DC input switch) aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If the alarm is one of the manually-cleared ones (2002, 2077, 2080), clear it in the app after fixing.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm manually-clear wale mein se hai (2002, 2077, 2080) to theek karne ke baad app mein clear karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED1 steady red, LED2 steady red

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Table 2-2 LED description

codes.code: LED1 Blinking red slowly + LED2 Steady green
aliases: LED1 Blinking red slowly + LED2 Steady green

title.ur: Power export ho raha hai lekin optimizer fault hai

meaning.en: LED1 blinks red slowly while LED2 is solid green: the inverter is still exporting, but an attached optimizer is faulty.
meaning.ur: LED1 slowly red blink aur LED2 solid green: inverter ab bhi export kar raha hai, lekin laga hua optimizer faulty hai.

causes.en: A connected SUN2000 optimizer has an internal fault or has lost communication.
causes.ur: Connected SUN2000 optimizer mein internal fault hai ya uski communication chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Optimizer cable or connector open at the optimizer end.
causes.ur: Optimizer ka cable ya connector optimizer end par khula hai.

solutions.en: Open the optimizer page in the app and note which optimizer serial is flagged.
solutions.ur: App mein optimizer page kholein aur note karein ke kaun sa optimizer serial flag ho raha hai.

solutions.en: With PV isolated, measure the optimizer output voltage; an optimizer should read near its module Voc, not 0 V.
solutions.ur: PV isolate kar ke optimizer output voltage measure karein; optimizer ko apne module ke Voc ke qareeb par dikhna chahiye, 0 V nahi.

solutions.en: Reseat the optimizer connectors and, if still faulty, replace the optimizer - not the inverter.
solutions.ur: Optimizer connectors dobara laga dein aur phir bhi faulty ho to optimizer badal dein - inverter nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: LED1 blinking red slowly (on 1s, off 1s), LED2 steady green

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Table 2-2 LED description

codes.code: LED1 Blinking red slowly + LED2 Steady orange
aliases: LED1 Blinking red slowly + LED2 Steady orange

title.ur: Backup mode chal raha hai lekin optimizer fault hai

meaning.en: LED1 blinks red slowly while LED2 is solid orange: the unit is in backup state and an optimizer is faulty.
meaning.ur: LED1 slowly red blink aur LED2 solid orange: unit backup state mein hai aur optimizer faulty hai.

causes.en: Backup mode active while an attached optimizer reports a fault.
causes.ur: Backup mode on hai aur attached optimizer fault report kar raha hai.

causes.en: Optimizer supply absent on the backup island, so the optimizer drops out.
causes.ur: Backup island par optimizer ka supply nahi hai, is liye optimizer drop out ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Confirm in the app whether the optimizer fault is real or is a side effect of no grid/optimizer supply.
solutions.ur: App par confirm karein ke optimizer fault asli hai ya grid/optimizer supply na hone ka asar hai.

solutions.en: With PV isolated, check optimizer connectors and the optimizer ribbon cable for a broken conductor.
solutions.ur: PV isolate kar ke optimizer connectors aur optimizer ribbon cable mein toota conductor check karein.

solutions.en: Return the site to grid-tied mode first, then re-read the optimizer status before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Pehle site ko grid-tied mode par la dein, phir parts badalne se pehle optimizer status dobara padhein.

codes.code: LED3 Blinking green at long intervals (1s on / 1s off)
aliases: LED3 Blinking green at long intervals (1s on / 1s off)

meaning.en: A phone is connected to the inverter - typically via the built-in WiFi access point.
meaning.ur: Phone inverter se connected hai - aam tor par built-in WiFi access point ke zariye.

causes.en: A technician's phone is in the local WiFi session with the inverter.
causes.ur: Technician ka phone inverter ke local WiFi session mein hai.

solutions.en: Read the alarm list on the phone while this state persists, then disconnect the phone to free the link.
solutions.ur: Is state mein phone par alarm list padhein, phir link khaal karne ke liye phone disconnect karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED3 blinking green at long intervals (on 1s, off 1s)

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Table 2-2 LED description

meaning.en: No communication with the management system.
meaning.ur: Management system ke saath communication nahi hai.

causes.en: Management system or app not connected, or the unit is powered off.
causes.ur: Management system ya app connected nahi, ya unit band hai.

solutions.en: If the unit is generating, check the WiFi antenna is seated and the app is on the correct site account.
solutions.ur: Agar unit generate kar raha hai to check karein ke WiFi antenna baithi hui hai aur app sahi site account par hai.

solutions.en: If the unit is off, confirm PV and AC are energised with a multimeter before blaming comms.
solutions.ur: Agar unit off hai to comms ko blame karne se pehle multimeter se PV aur AC energized hain confirm karein.
